definitions.explanation: The temperature of the body, typically measured to check for fever or illness.

examples.japanese: {体温|たいおん}を{測|はか}ってください。
{体温|たいおん}が38{度|ど}もある。
examples.english: My temperature is as high as 38 degrees.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}に{入|はい}る{前|まえ}に{体温|たいおん}チェックがあった。
examples.english: There was a temperature check before entering the hospital.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体温|たいおん}を{測|はか}る (to take one's temperature)
- {体温|たいおん}が{上|あ}がる (temperature rises)
- {体温|たいおん}が{下|さ}がる (temperature drops)
- {体温計|たいおんけい} (thermometer)

NORMAL RANGE: In Japan, normal body temperature is typically considered around 36-37°C (degrees Celsius).

RELATED TERMS:
- {熱|ねつ} (fever)
- {平熱|へいねつ} (normal body temperature)
